baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative قُلْ, the perfect verbs جَاءَ and زَهَقَ, the doubled الباطل, and كَانَ زَهُوقًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: A commanded utterance announces an asymmetric event: reality-matching truth becomes present, while what lacks truth and stability goes away until no trace remains. The final kāna plus intensive verbal noun makes vanishing falsehood's recurring disposition, not merely the result of one contest.

activation_trace.role: Vocalized speech makes the imperative an audible public announcement that stages the event.
Coming and obtaining supply truth's transition into operative presence.
Reality-matching stability defines the arriving term against falsehood.
Departure from truth and stability makes falsehood the structurally nonlasting term.
Going until the trace is cut off supplies both the event and the repeated disposition.
Occurrence in time lets kāna generalize falsehood's vanishing across occasions.

changed_reading.after: The commanded declaration marks truth becoming operative and exposes an asymmetry: falsehood does not merely lose once but bears recurrent self-erasure as its mode of being.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The command to say, الحق, and the doubled naming of الباطل around زَهَقَ and زَهُوقًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The line can be heard as public adjudication: a binding due or claim comes into force, while a claim without standing lapses. Repeating falsehood first as the vanishing subject and then as a class habitually marked by vanishing converts a verdict into a rule.

activation_trace.role: The image of a holder of effective speech activates a consequential pronouncement rather than bare description.
Binding obligation and fixed entitlement give truth the force of an enforceable due.
Lack of truth and stability supplies the rival claim's absence of standing.
Extinction of trace renders the invalid claim's lapse complete.
Temporal occurrence turns the particular ruling into a recurrent rule about false claims.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a metaphysical victory.
changed_reading.after: The verse also functions like a public ruling: a binding claim has arrived, and the claim lacking standing is pronounced lapsed by nature.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence turns arrival and disappearance into an enacted threshold rhythm. Maintained upright practice passes through night into dawn's breach, then asks for truthful ingress and egress; truth's coming is repeatedly entered, while falsehood loses continuity at each correctly crossed boundary.

activation_trace.role: Coming supplies the focus event that the surrounding thresholds repeatedly enact.
Trace-cutting departure makes each crossed threshold a loss of falsehood's continuity.
Straightening and maintaining uprightness supply a sustained practice rather than a momentary assertion.
A wide rupture and outburst make dawn a material image of truth breaking a closed interval.
Ingress supplies the first side of a controlled passage.
Complete soundness and stability qualify both passage directions as truth-bearing.
Egress completes the passage mechanism rather than leaving arrival as a static state.

structural_cues: 17:78-80 directly precede the focus and move from established timed practice through night and dawn to truthful entry and exit.
17:80 repeats the imperative قُل immediately before 17:81.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies maintained uprightness, dawn's breach, and truthful ingress and egress; I infer that these thresholds enact the focus event repeatedly. A live alternative is that they only prepare for a single historical arrival.

changed_reading.before: Truth arrives once and expels falsehood.
changed_reading.after: Truth's arrival is also a repeatable passage practiced across time and honest transitions, with falsehood shedding its hold whenever the boundary is crossed in truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same arriving communication produces opposed outcomes according to reception: it repairs and relieves one relation to it, yet compounds diminution in another. Falsehood's vanishing therefore becomes a diagnostic exposure process, not a uniformly comfortable removal.

activation_trace.role: Arrival provides the shared exposure whose effects the next ayah differentiates.
Instability makes falsehood vulnerable to exposure rather than a coequal durable substance.
Trace-cutting departure gives the harmful reception its terminal direction.
Delivery and conveyance turn abstract arrival into a communicated input.
Healing supplies the reparative outcome for receptive participants.
Increase supplies the counterintuitive amplification produced by resistant reception.
General diminution identifies the amplified outcome as progressive loss.

structural_cues: 17:82 immediately follows the focus and contrasts believers with wrongdoers under the same Quranic descent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one descending communication and opposite healing and loss outcomes; I infer that truth's arrival is the shared exposure and that vanishing can be experienced as loss by what resists it. A live alternative is that healing and loss are only later effects, not an unpacking of 17:81.

changed_reading.before: Truth removes falsehood in one uniform operation.
changed_reading.after: Truth arrives as a common exposure that heals receptive life while accelerating the loss already built into resistant falsehood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following behavioral cycle gives falsehood's habitual vanishing an agent-level mechanism. A person's operative shape generates turning aside and distance in ease, then severed hope under harm; the pattern consumes its own capacity to remain oriented when conditions reverse.

activation_trace.role: Constitutive instability is the focus property given a behavioral mechanism by the context.
Occurrence through time supports reading the predicate as a recurring disposition.
Departure until no trace remains names the endpoint of the self-exhausting pattern.
Turning the side away supplies the first evasive movement.
Distance extends evasion into a maintained separation.
Cutting off hope supplies the collapse reached when conditions reverse.
Intentional action makes the cycle operative rather than merely conceptual.
A governing way or direction supplies the disposition that repeatedly generates the cycle.

structural_cues: 17:83 repeats كَانَ with يَـُٔوسًا, formally echoing the focus's كَانَ زَهُوقًا before 17:84 names action according to a shākila.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies action according to a governing shape and a turn-away, distance, despair cycle; I infer that this is one concrete way falsehood proves inherently vanishing. A live alternative is that the cycle is only an adjacent anthropological example.

changed_reading.before: Falsehood vanishes because truth externally defeats it.
changed_reading.after: Falsehood also vanishes from within: its governing pattern produces evasion in ease and hopeless collapse in adversity, exhausting its own stability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The commanded speaker announces truth without owning its source or continued presence. Limited human knowledge, hidden imparting, the possibility of removal, and preservation as mercy recast the utterance as entrusted testimony to a gifted arrival.

activation_trace.role: Audible saying anchors the model in the speaker's commanded act.
Arrival remains the event whose custody, rather than human ownership, is at issue.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic capacity explicitly limited in the context.
Smallness bounds the recipients' possession of knowledge.
Going away makes the communicated truth's continued accessibility non-possessive and contingent.
Hidden imparting distinguishes the supplied knowledge from the speaker's independent production.
Merciful tenderness supplies the preserving exception to removal.
Gift and benefaction identify continued presence as bestowed surplus.

structural_cues: 17:85 repeats قُل, 17:86 says the revealed material could be taken away, and 17:87 makes mercy the exception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limited knowledge, revelation, possible removal, and merciful preservation; I infer that the focus speaker is a custodian announcing a gifted presence. A live alternative is that these verses discuss textual preservation independently of 17:81's truth claim.

changed_reading.before: The speaker possesses and proclaims a settled truth.
changed_reading.after: The speaker is commissioned to voice a truth whose arrival and continued accessibility are gifts held in trust, not products under human control.

context_deltas.mechanism: The arrival claim is tested through a reversal of production demands. A total coalition cannot bring an equivalent to the varied discourse, yet refusers then demand that the messenger bring a sequence of prescribed spectacles and a readable descending document. Falsehood persists by shifting from failed counterproduction to control over what may count as arrival.

activation_trace.role: Bringing and presenting makes the focus arrival the term reversed through the context's production demands.
Well-knit speech lets truth be tested as coherent discourse rather than only an abstract proposition.
Gathering all separated parties supplies maximal collective production capacity.
Coming or bringing names the failed attempt to produce a counterpart.
Equivalence supplies the comparison criterion the coalition cannot meet.
Turning material from form to form supplies the discourse's varied presentation.
Refusal explains why varied presentation does not end the dispute.
Speech without certainty marks the demanders' treatment of the prior claim.
The same coming and bringing image transfers the production burden to the messenger.
Demanded delivery specifies a controlled vertical form for acceptable evidence.
An ordered written object supplies the final prescribed product they insist on reading.

structural_cues: 17:88-89 move from impossible production of a likeness to refusal after varied examples.
17:90-93 then escalate through لَن, حَتَّى, and repeated أَو demands, reversing who must bring what.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed equivalent production followed by escalating prescribed productions; I infer that the reversal exposes criterion-shifting as falsehood's survival mechanism. A live alternative is that the challenge and demands are juxtaposed arguments without a causal shift between them.

changed_reading.before: Truth has arrived and falsehood simply lacks an answer.
changed_reading.after: Truth's arrival survives the strongest counterproduction test; falsehood then reveals its instability by moving the admissibility gate and demanding that reality arrive only in forms it controls.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next exchange turns truth's coming into a medium-recipient fit. Guidance has already come, but humans treat a human messenger as a barrier; the counterfactual answers that settled earth-walking angels would receive an angelic messenger. The carrier matches the recipients' embodied field, so rejecting that fit mistakes the delivery mechanism for a defect.

activation_trace.role: A fitting joint or receptacle activates truth as something correctly matched to its place.
A barrier between a person and what is sought identifies the mistaken objection's function.
The explicit coming of guidance reopens and specifies the focus arrival.
Gentle direction to the path identifies what has arrived through the messenger.
Visible-skinned humanity supplies the recipients' own embodied class as messenger medium.
Messenger and message bind the arriving guidance to a carrier.
Walking supplies the counterfactual recipients' mode of embodied movement.
Settled repose makes the hypothetical angelic population native to the earthly field.
Delivery from above supplies the matched messenger sent into that field.
The repeated messenger category completes the human-to-human and angel-to-angel correspondence.

structural_cues: 17:94 says guidance came yet belief was blocked by objection to a human messenger; 17:95 answers with a mirrored earth-dweller and messenger counterfactual.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrived guidance, a humanity objection, and a mirrored angelic counterfactual; I infer a medium-recipient matching rule. A live alternative is that 17:95 only rebuts a demand for angels and does not define how truth arrives generally.

changed_reading.before: Truth arrives as content separable from its carrier.
changed_reading.after: Truth's coming includes a fitted delivery: its carrier belongs to the recipients' lived field, and falsehood calls that very fitness an inadequacy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing command relocates final adjudication from the disputants to a sufficient witness who knows inner conditions and sees. The focus declaration is therefore not self-certifying rhetoric; it is testimony uttered under comprehensive verification.

activation_trace.role: Effective speech anchors the focus declaration as a consequential public pronouncement.
Binding right gives the pronouncement an adjudicative object.
Complete sufficiency assigns final verification to a witness beyond both disputing parties.
Knowledge-bearing testimony supplies the explicit adjudicative act.
Knowledge of reports and inward reality extends verification beneath public claims.
Insight of the heart supplies discernment of what outward sight alone may miss.

structural_cues: 17:96 closes the unit with another قُل and places a witness between speaker and audience after the disputed arrivals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sufficient witness with inward knowledge and insight; I infer that this witness grounds the focus verdict rather than the speaker's force doing so. A live alternative is that the closing witness only settles messenger credibility, not the full truth-falsehood mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The commanded statement certifies itself by force of assertion.
changed_reading.after: The statement is public testimony under a sufficient, inwardly informed witness; truth's arrival and falsehood's lapse are verified beyond the contesting speakers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates weapon and trajectory branches rather than the ordinary abstract senses. It remains valid as an analogy because the focus directly pairs a straight penetrating ح ق ق image with a target-overshooting ز ه ق image, while 17:84 supplies guidance and path. Downstream prose should mark it as a branch-driven spatial model, not replace the primary lexical reading with archery.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الحق at word 3 and both زَهَقَ and زَهُوقًا at words 4 and 9.

activation_trace.role: A straight thrust that penetrates supplies truth as accurate, effective trajectory.
An arrow passing beyond its target supplies falsehood as energetic motion that nevertheless misses its proper end.
Gentle direction toward truth makes target alignment contextually live.
An extended traversable path gives the paired trajectories a spatial field.

changed_reading.before: Truth and falsehood are static opposed contents.
changed_reading.after: They can also be pictured as rival trajectories: truth reaches and penetrates its proper place, whereas falsehood spends motion overshooting the target and disappearing beyond it.

strongest_changes: The pre-focus threshold sequence recasts a single victory as a repeatedly enacted passage through time, dawn, entry, and exit.
17:82 makes arrival a differential exposure that heals receptivity while accelerating resistant loss.
17:88-93 expose falsehood's criterion-shifting move from failed counterproduction to demands for controlled spectacle.
17:94-95 make truth's arrival recipient-fitted mediation rather than content detached from its carrier.
17:96 grounds the public verdict in sufficient, inwardly informed witness.
summary.what_was_special: Arrival, bringing, and descent recur around the focus while kāna plus intensive states echo its grammar; together they change abstract triumph into mechanisms of enacted threshold, differential exposure, self-exhausting disposition, failed counterproduction, fitted mediation, and witnessed adjudication.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether كَانَ زَهُوقًا names falsehood's intrinsic ontology or its recurrent observed behavior.
Whether 17:88-93 form one criterion-shifting mechanism or juxtapose independent proofs and demands.
Whether the preservation sequence in 17:85-87 directly revises the focus arrival or only concerns the revelation's continued accessibility.
The trajectory outlier depends on distant material branches and should remain explicitly analogical.
